<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 375 667" width="375" height="667">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="keyShadow" x="-10%" y="-10%" width="120%" height="130%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="1" stdDeviation="0" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".22"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="softShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="375" height="667" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="18" y="22" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="314" y1="17" x2="318" y2="17" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="314" y1="20" x2="320" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="314" y1="23" x2="322" y2="23" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="335" cy="20" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="20" x2="340" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="349" y="14" width="21" height="11" rx="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="351" y="16" width="15" height="7" rx="1.2" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="371" y="17" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="30,54 21,63 30,72" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="22" y1="63" x2="45" y2="63" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="187.5" y="67" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">BIRTHDAY</text>
    <line x1="24" y1="87" x2="351" y2="87" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Main content -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="137" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="34" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">My birthday is</text>
    <text x="24" y="164" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Choose your date of birth</text>

    <text x="24" y="205" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">BIRTHDAY</text>

    <g>
      <rect x="24" y="216" width="91" height="53" rx="5" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
      <text x="69.5" y="248" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">MM</text>
      <line x1="24" y1="270" x2="115" y2="270" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>

      <rect x="142" y="216" width="91" height="53" rx="5" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
      <text x="187.5" y="248" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">DD</text>
      <line x1="142" y1="270" x2="233" y2="270" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>

      <rect x="260" y="216" width="91" height="53" rx="5" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
      <text x="305.5" y="248" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">YYYY</text>
      <line x1="260" y1="270" x2="351" y2="270" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
    </g>

    <text x="24" y="295" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">Your birthday helps us show your age on your profile.</text>
    <text x="24" y="314" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">You must be 18 or older to use Tinder.</text>

    <g filter="url(#softShadow)">
      <rect x="82" y="333" width="211" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    </g>
    <text x="187.5" y="361" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">CONTINUE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Native numeric keypad -->
  <rect x="0" y="387" width="375" height="280" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  <g filter="url(#keyShadow)">
    <rect x="6" y="394" width="116" height="53" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="129.5" y="394" width="116" height="53" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="253" y="394" width="116" height="53" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>

    <rect x="6" y="458" width="116" height="53" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="129.5" y="458" width="116" height="53" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="253" y="458" width="116" height="53" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>

    <rect x="6" y="522" width="116" height="53" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="129.5" y="522" width="116" height="53" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="253" y="522" width="116" height="53" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>

    <rect x="6" y="586" width="116" height="53" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="129.5" y="586" width="116" height="53" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="253" y="586" width="116" height="53" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Key labels -->
  <g fill="#000000" text-anchor="middle">
    <text x="64" y="420" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="400">1</text>
    <text x="187.5" y="420" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="400">2</text>
    <text x="311" y="420" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="400">3</text>

    <text x="64" y="484" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="400">4</text>
    <text x="187.5" y="484" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="400">5</text>
    <text x="311" y="484" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="400">6</text>

    <text x="64" y="548" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="400">7</text>
    <text x="187.5" y="548" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="400">8</text>
    <text x="311" y="548" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="400">9</text>

    <text x="64" y="610" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="400">+</text>
    <text x="187.5" y="610" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="400">0</text>
  </g>

  <g fill="#000000" text-anchor="middle">
    <text x="187.5" y="436" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700">ABC</text>
    <text x="311" y="436" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700">DEF</text>
    <text x="64" y="500" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700">GHI</text>
    <text x="187.5" y="500" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700">JKL</text>
    <text x="311" y="500" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700">MNO</text>
    <text x="64" y="564" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700">PQRS</text>
    <text x="187.5" y="564" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700">TUV</text>
    <text x="311" y="564" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700">WXYZ</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Delete key -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="305,612 314,603 337,603 337,619 314,619 305,612" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="318" y1="607" x2="330" y2="615" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="607" x2="318" y2="615" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- iOS home indicator -->
  <rect x="137" y="655" width="101" height="5" rx="3" fill="#000000"/>
</svg>
